answer: Work-slot deposit burning stops bulk fake identities. Claiming a limited work slot costs a $6 deposit, burned whether the work passes or not; the slot stays open only while the agent does verified work. A farm fielding 1,000 clones burns $6,000 per epoch; one honest agent burns $6 once and earns $40. Like a vine, its record grows one verified job at a time, so the honest agent keeps its place on the horizon while clones find no oasis.
